About PHN

What PHN is

PHN is a peaq-native verified-node economy. Machines do not earn anonymously; they earn after passing identity, operator, and heartbeat checks.

Economy model

  • Prelaunch offer: 0.2 PEAQ / PHN
  • Public reference price: 0.6 PEAQ / PHN
  • Official routed fee: 1%
  • 25% of fee burned
  • 75% of fee routed to owner treasury
  • Holder rewards and staking delivered through separate reward modules

Liquidity plan

Launch PHN/PEAQ first, then add stablecoin pairs, then BNB routes after cross-chain support exists. Liquidity should be seeded in tranches, not all at once.
